FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Do you serve countries outside Nigeria and Côte d'Ivoire?

Yes. We handle visas and travel for applicants from every African country. Documents can be sent online, and our team follows up by WhatsApp, phone or email.

What documents do I need for an Umrah visa?

Usually a passport valid for at least six months, a recent passport photo and, in some cases, a vaccination certificate. We confirm the current requirements for your nationality when you contact us.

How long does the visa take?

Processing times vary by season and visa type. We advise starting at least 3–4 weeks before your planned departure.

Can women travel with your groups?

Yes. We explain the current Saudi rules for women travellers and arrange suitable group or family travel.

How do I pay?

After you accept the quote, we share secure payment options. Always request an official receipt.
